Economy · India

Indian banks see faster loan growth than deposits in Q1

Indian banks experienced significant loan growth in the first quarter of the fiscal year, with advances surging for many lenders. However, this growth outpaced the rise in deposits, leading to a widening gap for some banks. Public sector banks showed more stable credit-deposit growth compared to private lenders.
